final_assistant_text:
Case F21 complete. Final mask saved (v2, 605.0 mL) for the fibrous soft-tissue tumor of the posterior compartment:

- **Location/extent:** large T2-heterogeneous, lobulated mass with a low-signal capsule and internal fibrous (dark) bands; axial k≈207–380, coronal j≈27–140, sagittal i≈101–210 (~11 × 11 × 17 cm).
- **Method:** positive points at the mass core on axial 310 → model mask (v1, 514 mL) → checked and refined (v2, 605 mL) for smoother, fuller boundary coverage; verified margins and both ends on multiple axial/coronal/sagittal slices.
- **Rejected:** automatic candidates C1–C3, which were whole-limb intensity proposals including fat/muscle.
- **Confidence: medium** — boundary clear against the dark capsule in all three planes, though the tumor–edema transition at the poles is somewhat subtle.
